description: Tiny MLP model for irrigation decision (irrigate / no irrigation). Input: 13 one-hot encoded features. Output: single sigmoid probability.

raw_features.name: water_requirement
raw_features.description: Expected daily water requirement (reference crop ET)

input.feature_order_description: 13 features. Likely: 5 numerical (soil moisture, temperature, humidity, etc.) + 8 one-hot crop type. Update this config if you know the exact training feature columns.

feature_normalization.comment: Normalize numerical features before quantization. The quantization scale (0.0725) is larger than fertilizer model, suggesting wider float range.

evaluation.note: Run evaluation module with labeled test data to obtain accuracy.

irrigate.message: Model recommends irrigation. Consider irrigating within the next 24 hours.
actions: Check soil moisture sensor readings to confirm low moisture
Verify weather forecast for upcoming rainfall
Apply irrigation water at recommended rate for the crop type
Monitor soil moisture after irrigation and adjust schedule accordingly

no_irrigation.message: Model indicates no irrigation is required at this time.
actions: Reassess within 24-48 hours or after significant temperature change
Maintain irrigation schedule log for future reference
